description: Multi-sensor dataset for normal air, Methyl Mercaptan and Hydrogen Sulfide gas classification is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mittuniversitetet. The dataset includes time-series data collected by four different sensors, which measure two target gases, Hydrogen Sulfide and Methyl Mercaptan, in the presence of air. To obtain measurements, each gas was individually exposed to the multi-sensor setup while in the presence of air. Coverage: Mittuniversitetet. The publisher named on the listing is Mittuniversitetet. Its keywords include Methyl Mercaptan, Gas classification, Deep learning, Data fusion, Multi sensor, Hydrogen Sulfide. The listing shows 2025-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
